theme: Shaadi Season (and a Very Black Friday)

segments.title: November
segments.text: Hello Pop-up! November is Shaadi Season, and a very Black Friday. Half our members have a wedding to dance at, and the other half have a sale to wait for. We have something for both.

segments.title: ₹1.81L
segments.text: So, the number. Our November target for Pop-up is 1.81 lakh rupees. That's 44 per cent above last November. We're growing, and the plan knows exactly how.

segments.title: 3 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? New clients lead the way with 99,700 rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then renewals 79,800, and everything else 1,800. New clients carry this month, so every trial is a first impression worth getting right.

segments.title: 48 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 562 leads, 146 trials, and 48 buyers, with about 33 per cent of trials converting. Roughly one in five trials becomes a member. Our job is to make it one in four.
Here's where the offers come in. Three offers carry 1.03 lakh rupees, which is 57 per cent of our target. The rest is full-price. Offers open the door. Great classes keep it open. Let's meet them.

segments.title: 11.11: Treat Yourself, Not Your Ex
segments.text: First up, eleven eleven: treat yourself, not your ex. Eleven hours only, eight-class packs at twenty per cent off. One per person. The plan is 4 buyers at about 5,500, so 22,200 rupees.
segments.notes: Everyone: newcomers, pack buyers and members.

segments.title: Bride Squad, Assemble (Groom Can Come Too)
segments.text: Next, Bride Squad, Assemble. The groom can come too. Four or more of you, at least two new, buy twelve-class packs together at twelve per cent off and get a private Squad Class that ends on a Sangeet routine. The plan is 10 buyers at about 6,600, so 65,800 rupees.
segments.notes: Wedding parties and friend groups (min 4, at least 2 new).

segments.title: Black Friday Blind Box (No Duds)
segments.text: And finally, the Black Friday Blind Box. No duds. Renew for three, six or twelve months and pick a sealed box: extra days, guest passes, a private. Every box wins, and one annual box per studio hides the hoodie. The plan is 2 buyers at about 7,700, so 15,300 rupees.
segments.notes: Members renewing or upgrading; annual renewers due Nov–Jan.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, bride squads and wedding parties get their group rate. Week two, eleven eleven: eleven hours of pack prices, and no exes invited. Week three, a mid-month check against the target. Week four, the Black Friday Blind Box, four days, long plans only, and no duds.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's November at Pop-up. 1.81 lakh rupees, three offers, and 48 buyers to welcome. Wedding-ready and fully booked. That's November.
segments.signoff: Wedding-ready and fully booked. That's November.
